text:
Source-assisted reading of F-0w8s (Stams, Stiftsarchiv, Frg. 71). Reread on the native images by a research reader: canvas 0, right column, from the top to the heading De translatione (region 3330,640,1230,1980); canvas 1, left column, first thirty lines or so (region 2980,620,1280,1960); and the five red headings. Read before the source was known: "possit eligi ... eligatur", "valet electio pauco[rum]", "consentire [..] dissentire electioni", "secundum omnes", "An soli pape", "significasti", "que non possunt". All other words below were read with the 1513 edition of Guillelmus Durantis, Repertorium aureum, open beside the image. Regions are x,y,width,height in native pixels. Parentheses expand abbreviations; [..] marks letters lost or not read; (?) marks an uncertain reading. Everything not listed here rests on the image-only first reading.
